nodes.description: Public string state variable holding the token URI extension ('.json').
Public uint256 state variable for the mint price (30 ether).
Public uint256 state variable for the maximum token supply (1123).
Public uint256 state variable limiting tokens minted per transaction (10).
Public bool state variable used to pause minting.
Public string state variable holding the IPFS base URI prefix.
Public payable mint function that validates limits and mints tokens via nextToken and _safeMint.
Public view function returning the metadata URI for a token id.
Owner-only payable function sending the contract balance to msg.sender via low-level send.
Internal view override returning the baseURI state variable.
Internal overridden function in RandomlyAssigned generating a pseudo-random token id using block values.
Internal ERC721 mint that triggers onERC721Received on contract recipients.
Caller-controlled address used as mint recipient and withdrawal target.
Miner-influenceable block timestamp used as entropy in the random index generation.
Low-level payable(msg.sender).send(address(this).balance) call in withdraw.
Arithmetic multiplication cost * _SHBSMintAmount used for payment validation.
External callback invoked on recipient contract during _safeMint, enabling reentrancy.
Caller-supplied parameter controlling how many tokens are minted in mintSHBSS.
Local variable in mintSHBSS storing the token id returned by nextToken().
Parameter of tokenURI identifying the token whose metadata is queried.
Local variable in nextToken computed as maxSupply() - tokenCount() and used as modulo range.

edges.reason: mintSHBSS reads the paused state variable to gate execution.
mintSHBSS reads maxSHBSMintAmount to bound the mint amount.
mintSHBSS reads maxSHBS to bound total supply.
mintSHBSS reads cost to validate msg.value.
mintSHBSS computes cost * _SHBSMintAmount, a multiplication that could overflow.
mintSHBSS uses _msgSender() (msg.sender) as the mint recipient.
mintSHBSS calls nextToken() inside the mint loop.
mintSHBSS calls _safeMint which performs an external callback before state is settled.
mintSHBSS consumes the caller-supplied _SHBSMintAmount parameter.
mintSHBSS assigns nextToken() result to the local mintIndex.
The _SHBSMintAmount argument feeds the cost * amount multiplication.
_SHBSMintAmount indirectly drives how many _safeMint calls occur.
msg.sender is passed as the recipient to _safeMint.
_safeMint invokes onERC721Received on the recipient contract, a reentrancy vector.
The recipient callback can re-enter with the same msg.sender before mint state finalizes.
withdraw executes the low-level send of the contract balance.
withdraw targets msg.sender as the recipient of the balance.
msg.sender supplies the payable recipient for the low-level send call.
tokenURI reads baseURI to build the metadata URI.
tokenURI reads baseExtension when concatenating the URI.
tokenURI consumes the tokenId parameter for existence check and encoding.
_baseURI returns the baseURI state variable.
nextToken uses block.timestamp as entropy for the pseudo-random index, a miner-influenceable dependency.
nextToken reads maxSupply (maxSHBS) to compute the index range.
nextToken assigns maxSupply() - tokenCount() to the local maxIndex.

normalization_plan.reason: The mint amount parameter only exists to bound and drive the mintSHBSS loop.
mintIndex is a transient local inside mintSHBSS holding the nextToken result.
tokenId is used only within tokenURI for the existence check and URI encoding.
maxIndex is a transient local computation inside nextToken used as the modulo range.
